subject: Biology
title: Tapetum & Sporopollenin NCERT Facts
content: Cells of tapetum possess dense cytoplasm and generally have more than one nucleus. Pollen grain exine is made of sporopollenin — the most resistant organic material known.

subject: Physics
title: Gauss Law & Electric Flux
content: Total electric flux through any closed surface is equal to 1/ε₀ times the net charge enclosed by the surface (Φ = q_in / ε₀).

subject: Chemistry
title: Raoult Law & Azeotropes
content: Minimum boiling azeotropes show large positive deviation from Raoult law (e.g. 95% ethanol + water mixture).
